title: SAMPLE: Questions to ask about admissions and scholarships
source_organization: PathBridge AI capstone demonstration — not an official source
content: SAMPLE ONLY: A demonstration checklist, not a scholarship listing or admissions policy. When exploring admissions, scholarships, or financial aid, ask a counselor to help locate the current official program page. Questions to verify include application dates, eligibility rules, required documents, total costs, and whether aid must be repaid. Do not assume that meeting one condition guarantees admission or funding. This sample verifies no institution, scholarship, deadline, cost, or eligibility requirement.
